title: Harappan civilisation
examples: What were the main features of Harappan city layout?
What evidence do we have about Harappan trade?
What are the main theories about the end of the civilization?

explain.say: The Harappan civilization had very organized cities.
They built streets that ran in a neat grid pattern.
Every house had advanced drainage systems underneath.
The Harappans traded goods with faraway places.
They used standardized weights and measures for trade.
The decline of the civilization is debated by historians.

faq.q: Did they use money for trade?
faq.a: Archaeologists do not find evidence of a standard currency system. They likely used barter, exchanging goods directly.
asks: Was there a form of money?

faq.q: How did they manage the waste in their cities?
faq.a: They engineered sophisticated drainage systems. These drains were covered and connected to main sewer lines.

faq.q: What was the most important trade item?
faq.a: Seals carved with animals and symbols are very important. They suggest long-distance trade connections.
asks: What did they trade the most?

faq.q: Was it one single event that caused them to decline?
faq.a: Most historians believe the decline was gradual. It was likely due to a combination of factors, not just one thing.

faq.q: What does the grid pattern tell us about their society?
faq.a: The grid pattern suggests strong central planning and organized authority in the city's development.
asks: Who was in charge of building?

facts: Harappan cities featured a distinct division between a citadel and a lower town.
The drainage system was advanced, with covered drains running beneath the streets.
Trade goods were exchanged with regions like Mesopotamia.
The decline is often linked to changes in river patterns or climate.

quiz.say: The Harappans were skilled at planning their cities. What was the most noticeable feature of their street layout?
quiz.why: This shows advanced, organized urban planning.

wrong.1: Curving paths are more common in later city developments.
wrong.2: A single road suggests less complex urban life.
wrong.3: This ignores the clear evidence of standardized construction.

quiz.say: Evidence from Harappan sites suggests they engaged in trade. Which type of item best proves long-distance trade?

options.show: Seals found far from the Indus Valley
options.say: Seals found far from the Indus Valley

quiz.why: Finding items from other regions proves trade links.

wrong.0: These only show what lived nearby.
wrong.2: These only prove local daily life, not trade.
wrong.3: Bricks show local building skill, not trade reach.

quiz.say: When considering the decline, which theory suggests environmental change was a major factor?
quiz.why: Changes in water sources would affect agriculture greatly.

wrong.0: Trade issues are usually symptoms, not the main cause.
wrong.2: This suggests a single military cause, ignoring slow change.
wrong.3: This focuses only on people, ignoring natural causes.
